text: ∀x (BalancedDiet(x) ∧ IncludesVariety(x, Fruits) ∧ IncludesVariety(x, Vegetables) ∧ IncludesVariety(x, LeanProteins) → (ProvidesEssentialNutrients(x) ∧ PromotesOverallHealthAndWellness(x))) ::: A balanced diet that includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, and lean proteins can provide essential nutrients and promote overall health and wellness.
